verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a first-party Next.js integration (clerk-docs-19) and a CLI that detects the project's framework and adds the needed auth files (clerk-docs-37). It also issues short-lived JWT session tokens for authenticating backend requests (clerk-docs-6, clerk-docs-22), and a community user praises the Next.js integration (clerk-comm-11). However, the pack never shows route-protection middleware or edge-runtime session verification. missing for 10: explicit middleware/route-protection docs, evidence of session verification at the edge, documented SDKs for peer frameworks beyond Next.js.
